test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some Bags are Waters.

All Waters are Liquids.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some Liquids are Bags.

II. All Bags are Liquids.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/690eb0614e42f158a87348dd9febb33c5a26104f90b970223194620f841af867.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Liquids are Bags → Follow (As some Bags are Waters and all Waters are Liquids. As some part of bags is common with waters which whole comes in liquids, therefore it is true.)

II. All Bags are Liquids → Does not follow (As some Bags are Waters and all Waters are Liquids. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
